name: Translation
description: Translate whole files with the LibreTranslate that runs on THIS machine (no cloud, no key); the text goes nowhere else. Give the target in the extra arguments: to=fr (or de, ja, es ...); from=auto by default. The kind of file is read from the INPUT's extension: .md keeps headings, lists, quotes, front matter and code blocks; .srt and .vtt keep cue numbers and times and translate only the text; .txt is translated line by line. Code, `inline code`, URLs, link targets, <html tags>, {placeholders} and %s are never sent for translation and come back exactly. If a machine translation loses a protected piece or a link's brackets, THAT line is left in the original language and reported (file(line) Warning: ...), never a half-broken line. A report is written next to the output (.report.md). Right-to-left lines that mix code and links most often need a second look. Check says whether LibreTranslate answers and which languages it has; Languages lists them.

presets.label: Translate a text file (.txt)
presets.description: Extra argument: to=he (required). Paragraph by paragraph; blank lines kept.

presets.label: Translate Markdown (.md)
presets.description: Extra argument: to=he (required). Headings, lists, quotes, front matter, code and links are kept.

presets.label: Translate SRT subtitles
presets.description: Extra argument: to=he (required). Numbers and times untouched; check the result with the Subtitles tool.

presets.label: Translate WebVTT subtitles
presets.description: Extra argument: to=he (required). Header, cue ids and times untouched.

presets.label: Check: does LibreTranslate answer
presets.description: Reports the address, and the languages when it is up.
